purpose: Curated global vehicle catalog seed for make/model/year selection with engine-family hints. Year ranges are model-family coverage ranges, not VIN-level fitment. Engine families are high-level guidance, not exact market/year configurations.

source.name: NHTSA vPIC
source.note: Use vPIC for dynamic make/model/year refresh and VIN decoding; keep market-specific engine and ECU data separate.
source.engine_note: Engine families are curated guidance layered on top of the make/model/year seed. They are not a substitute for VIN decoding or market-specific OEM fitment.
